description: Add shared_preferences dependency and create the auth foundation layer: AuthUserModel, AuthService interface + MockAuthService, and AuthProvider. These are the data and logic contracts that FEAT-002 (screens) depends on.
steps: Add 'shared_preferences: ^2.2.3' to the dependencies section of pubspec.yaml (after 'intl: ^0.19.0'). Run `flutter pub get` to resolve.

Create lib/models/auth_models.dart. Define: (a) AuthUser class with fields — String phone, String name, String email, DateTime? dateOfBirth, bool whatsappUpdates, int stars, bool isNewUser. Add const constructor, copyWith, toJson/fromJson for shared_preferences persistence. (b) AuthStatus enum: unauthenticated, loading, authenticated, guest.

Create lib/services/auth_service.dart. Define abstract interface AuthService with: Future<bool> sendOtp(String phone), Future<AuthUser?> verifyOtp(String phone, String otp), Future<AuthUser> saveProfile({required String phone, required String name, String? email, DateTime? dateOfBirth, bool whatsappUpdates}), Future<AuthUser?> getStoredSession(), Future<void> logout(). Phone validation static method: bool isValidIndianMobile(String phone) — exactly 10 digits, starts with 6-9.

Create lib/services/mock_auth_service.dart implementing AuthService. All methods use Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 900)) to simulate network. sendOtp: validates phone, returns true always for valid numbers. verifyOtp: returns AuthUser if otp == '123456', null otherwise. getStoredSession: reads from shared_preferences key 'auth_user' (JSON), returns AuthUser? or null. saveProfile: creates/updates AuthUser, saves to shared_preferences. logout: clears 'auth_user' key. Use shared_preferences package (SharedPreferences.getInstance()). Returning user detection: if shared_preferences already has a record for that phone number, set isNewUser=false.

Create lib/providers/auth_provider.dart extending ChangeNotifier. Fields: AuthService _authService (injected via constructor, defaults to MockAuthService()), AuthUser? _currentUser, AuthStatus _status = AuthStatus.unauthenticated, bool _isGuest = false, String? _error, bool _isLoading = false. Getters: currentUser, status, isLoggedIn (status==authenticated && !_isGuest), isGuest, error, isLoading, isNewUser (_currentUser?.isNewUser ?? true). Methods: Future<bool> sendOtp(String phone) — sets loading, calls service, updates state; Future<bool> verifyOtp(String phone, String otp) — calls service, sets _currentUser, determines isNewUser, returns success bool; Future<void> saveProfile({name, email, dob, whatsapp}) — calls service.saveProfile, updates _currentUser, notifies; void loginAsGuest() — sets _isGuest=true, _status=authenticated; Future<void> logout() — calls service.logout, resets all state; Future<void> checkSession() — calls service.getStoredSession(), if non-null sets _currentUser and _status=authenticated. Add initState-style init: static Future<AuthProvider> create() that calls checkSession.
acceptance_criteria: pubspec.yaml contains 'shared_preferences: ^2.2.3' and `flutter pub get` resolves without errors
lib/models/auth_models.dart compiles with no errors, AuthUser.toJson/fromJson round-trips correctly
lib/services/mock_auth_service.dart: verifyOtp('any_phone', '123456') returns non-null AuthUser; verifyOtp('any_phone', '999999') returns null
lib/providers/auth_provider.dart compiles with no errors and exports the expected API
verification: cd /Users/rajneesharya/Desktop/Flutter/brew_buddy && flutter analyze lib/models/auth_models.dart lib/services/mock_auth_service.dart lib/services/auth_service.dart lib/providers/auth_provider.dart
findings: FIELD NAMES (AuthUser): phone, name, email, dateOfBirth (DateTime?), whatsappUpdates (bool), stars (int), isNewUser (bool). All fields have safe defaults so the const constructor can be called with just 'phone'. SHARED_PREFS KEY: 'auth_user' (a single JSON string keyed to the logged-in user). NEW-USER LOGIC: a phone number that has no entry in shared_prefs is treated as new; once saveProfile() is called isNewUser is set to false and persisted. WELCOME STARS: saveProfile() adds 20 stars on the very first save (new user); subsequent saves preserve the existing star balance. MOCK OTP: '123456' is the only accepted code (const _kValidOtp in mock_auth_service.dart). NETWORK DELAY: 900 ms via Future.delayed (const _kNetworkDelay). AUTH PROVIDER API: sendOtp(phone) → Future<bool>, verifyOtp(phone, otp) → Future<bool>, saveProfile({name, email, dateOfBirth, whatsappUpdates}) → Future<void>, loginAsGuest() → void, logout() → Future<void>, checkSession() → Future<void>, static create() → Future<AuthProvider>. STATIC HELPER: AuthService.isValidIndianMobile(phone) — strips spaces/hyphens then checks ^[6-9]\d{9}$. PROVIDER REGISTRATION: AuthProvider is NOT yet wired into MultiProvider in main.dart — FEAT-002 or the wiring step should add ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => AuthProvider()) to the MultiProvider list and call checkSession() before runApp (or use AuthProvider.create()). TEST FILE: test/widget_test.dart was updated from the default scaffold test (referenced non-existent MyApp) to a smoke test using BrewBuddyApp.
